evidence: Isolation: task/task.toml:27-28 [verifier] environment_mode = "separate" with its own tests/Dockerfile (COPY . /tests, chmod -R go-rwx /tests at line 43-44); agent image environment/Dockerfile copies only instructions/ and assets/, not tests/ or solution/. [verifier.environment] network_mode="public" (line 37-38) - correct per delivery profile, no allowlist needed. test.sh:63-66 refuses to run without REWARDKIT_JUDGE/REWARDKIT_MODEL and passes no model override to rewardkit (line 207-209); no literal key/token anywhere in task tomls/sh/Dockerfiles (grep). judge.toml: all five (gates/render, gates/constraints, scored/functional, scored/polish, scored/visual) carry only judge = "claude-code" at line 5 (expected fallback) plus a comment; grep for model/temperature/effort finds no setting - only the explanatory comment. Criterion-level weight fields are rubric criteria weights, also present in the template, not judge-level model settings. Pinning: tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template (diff empty): @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 (pins its Playwright Chromium build), express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7; tests/tools identical to template. Base images are tag-pinned (node:22-bookworm-slim, python:3.12-slim) without digests and apt is unpinned - template-controlled and NOTE-level per deterministic-checks wording, not a task defect. Adversarial: a model= line or alternate REWARDKIT_MODEL/base URL would be caught by the diff - none present; a conforming task could not do better since the block is frozen. Runtime: no full configured verifier launch is in the raw evidence index (its scope states full configured grading is absent), so credential acceptance by OpenRouter / model recognition (cf. Colderwater lesson 20 'unrecognized_model') is not measured here; that gap belongs to the separate full-verifier-launch runtime record, and this row's static wiring requirement is fully met.
